title: European Commission, Shaping Europe's digital future: Commission preliminarily finds TikTok's 'For You' feed in breach of Digital Services Act for harmful 'rabbit holes' effect
what_it_says: The Commission's summary of its 6 November 2026 press release: a preliminary finding that TikTok's recommender system breaches the DSA through a rabbit hole effect, on risk assessment and mitigation. Page last updated 11 November 2026. The full press release (IP/26/2361) is rendered by script and was not read here.
